title: feat: metadata CRUD, form dialog, detail page, registry extensions, actions & permissions
body:
MetadataManagerPage only supported list + delete. This adds full CRUD, a detail page, custom actions, role-based permissions, and the registry extensions needed to drive them.

### Registry extensions (`metadataTypeRegistry.ts`)
- New `MetadataFormFieldDef` type and `formFields` property on `MetadataTypeConfig` — standardizes create/edit form structure per type
- New `detailComponent` property for custom detail renderers
- New `MetadataActionDef` type and `actions` property for custom page-level and row-level action buttons (with `scope: 'page' | 'row'`, `variant`, `icon`, `handler`)
- `DEFAULT_FORM_FIELDS` constant (name, label, description) as fallback
- `formFields` populated for dashboard, page, report entries

### MetadataFormDialog (`components/MetadataFormDialog.tsx`)
- Generic create/edit dialog driven by registry `formFields`
- Supports text, textarea, select field types
- Required validation, `disabledOnEdit` for immutable keys (e.g. `name`), loading state during submission

```tsx
<MetadataFormDialog
  open={formOpen}
  onOpenChange={setFormOpen}
  mode="edit"
  typeLabel={config.label}
  formFields={config.formFields}
  initialValues={item}
  onSubmit={handleSave}
/>
```

### MetadataManagerPage enhancements
- **Create**: "New {Type}" button in header opens create dialog
- **Edit**: Per-item edit button opens pre-filled edit dialog
- **Navigate**: Card click navigates to detail page
- **Custom actions**: Page-level actions rendered in header; row-level actions rendered per item card
- **Permissions**: Create/edit/delete buttons hidden for non-admin users via `useAuth()` role check
- All mutations via `MetadataService.saveMetadataItem()` with toast feedback, loading state, list refresh

### MetadataDetailPage (`pages/system/MetadataDetailPage.tsx`)
- Route: `/system/metadata/:metadataType/:itemName` (added to all 3 route blocks)
- Displays item fields from registry config, edit via MetadataFormDialog
- Supports custom renderers via `detailComponent` in registry
- **Permissions**: Edit button hidden for non-admin users via `useAuth()` role check

### Permission integration
- Both MetadataManagerPage and MetadataDetailPage use `useAuth()` from `@object-ui/auth` to check `user.role === 'admin'`
- Create, edit, and delete buttons are hidden for non-admin users
- Matches the pattern used by UserManagementPage, RoleManagementPage, and other system pages

### Tests
- 38 new tests across 4 files (MetadataFormDialog: 15, MetadataDetailPage: 8, MetadataManagerPage: 8 new, metadataTypeRegistry: 7 new)
- All 62 metadata-related tests pass
